(2) The criteria do not constitute unfair discrimination under Article 10 of the Constitution of the Republic of Namibia and the Labour Act 11 of 2007. (3) Where sensitive selection criteria have been applied, I have provided a lawful justification. (4) I understand that Illumin360 may suspend access if this declaration is found to be false. (5) I am authorised to make this declaration on behalf of the employer organisation.

22.2 — Gap Analysis Card (70-85% score band)
Appears in Section 3 of the shortlist report for candidates scoring between 70% and 85%. Shows specific gaps and compensating strengths.
PM
P. Mutumwa
Financial Accountant · Windhoek
78%
match score · Rank 3
Score in gap analysis range: 70-85%
P. Mutumwa holds a BCom Accounting (NQF 7) from UNAM, meeting the qualification requirement. Four years of financial accounting experience approaches but does not fully meet the five-year minimum. Skills alignment is strong with SAP and IFRS listed. City preference matches. Currently employed and actively seeking.
Areas for consideration
• Candidate has 4 years of relevant experience against the minimum requirement of 5 years — a gap of approximately 1 year.
• OHS certification not found in profile. No equivalent certification identified.
Compensating strengths
• Experience shortfall is partially offset by strong skills alignment (91%) — all five required technical tools explicitly listed in CV.
• BCom Accounting from UNAM directly matches the qualification requirement — no gap at NQF level.

29 — Employer Assistant
The employer assistant knows the employer's request history, billing, and platform features. Answers recruitment and billing questions instantly.
✦
Illumin360 — Employer Assistant
Hello! I can help you with your recruitment requests, reports, billing, and platform features. What would you like to know?
What is the difference between the internal recruitment link and the standard talent pool search?
Great question. The standard talent pool search searches Illumin360's national pool of active subscribed job seekers — ideal when you want to discover candidates who are actively looking for new opportunities.

The internal recruitment link generates a private portal that you share with your own staff — it is designed for internal promotions or roles where you want only current employees to apply. It costs NAD 2,300 (versus NAD 1,725 for standard) and includes a branded portal, application management, and the Illumin360 shortlist report — all billed in one invoice when you unlock the report.

Which type of vacancy are you filling?
29 — Job Seeker Assistant

Illumin360 — Your Career Assistant
Hi Thembi! Your profile is looking good — 72% complete. You have been shortlisted twice this month. How can I help you today?
How do I get to 100% profile completion?
You are at 72% — here is exactly what is missing to reach 100%:

✓ Certifications section — you have not added any certifications yet. Even listing relevant short courses helps.
✓ Professional summary — add a 2-3 sentence summary about your career goals and strengths.
✓ City preferences — you currently only have Windhoek selected. Consider adding other cities if you are open to relocation.

Adding these three things takes about 5 minutes and will significantly increase your chances of appearing in employer shortlists. Want me to walk you through each one?

D-12 — Data retention notice
Displayed in account settings and the Privacy Policy page for all logged-in users.
Your data and how long we keep it
Active account
Your data is retained for as long as your account is active and your subscription is current.
Expired subscription (job seeker)
Profile data retained for 24 months after expiry. Profile inactive and not searchable. Reactivate any time by purchasing a new subscription.
Expired subscription (student)
Profile data retained for 24 months after grace period expires. Permanently deleted after unless upgraded to paid subscription.
Deleted account
Personal data permanently deleted within 30 days. Financial records retained for 7 years for tax compliance.
Internal recruitment applicants
CV and application data retained for 12 months after portal closing date, then permanently deleted.
Audit and compliance records
Payment history, compliance justifications, and audit logs retained for 7 years.
To request early deletion of your data: info@illumininvestments.com
